CupsPolicy.description: The Policy schema contains properties related to a given CUPS Policy.
CupsPolicy.longDescription: The Policy schema contains properties related to a given CUPS Policy.

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

AlertsEnabled.description: Status of alert generation by this policy.
AlertsEnabled.longDescription: This property shall contain value defining action to be taken when threshold is crossed. When set to true, alert will be sent to defined target.

AveragingWindow.description: Averaging window over which policy monitors its metrics.
AveragingWindow.longDescription: This property shall contain value averaging window over which policy monitors its metrics.

Oem.longDescription: This property shall contain the OEM extensions.  All values for properties that this object contains shall conform to the Redfish Specification-described requirements.

PolicyStorage.longDescription: This property shall contain value defining configuration for policy storage option.

Status.description: The status and health of the Resource and its subordinate or dependent Resources.
Status.longDescription: This property shall contain any status or health properties of the Resource.

Threshold.longDescription: This property shall contain value of threshold for this policy.

enumDescriptions.Persistent: Policy is stored in non-volatile memory.
enumDescriptions.Volatile: Policy is only stored in volatile memory.
